preconditions.name: enough_testable_seeds
preconditions.note: 3/3 seeds are TESTABLE (BP-depth-3 ceiling holds AND BP-depth-2 underfits); need >= 3 for a decisive verdict. Per-seed ceiling-gating: a seed where the ORACLE cannot fit carries no info.

preconditions.name: backprop_oracle_ceiling_exists
preconditions.note: mean BP-depth-3 loss 2.064e-05 <= 0.001674 (2% of var 0.08371) on testable seeds

preconditions.name: depth_separating_on_fit
preconditions.note: mean BP-depth-2 0.03288 > BP-depth-3 2.064e-05 by > 0.004186 (5% of var): the target is depth-3-ENGAGING on FIT

preconditions.name: fixed_dfa_baseline_fails_to_reach_layer3
preconditions.note: the prior banked result reproduces: fixed-DFA closes -16.9% of the BP2->BP3 fit gap (< 50%) -> it does NOT reach the 3rd hidden layer. This is the baseline KP must beat.

preconditions.name: permuted_target_does_not_learn_fit
preconditions.note: KP on per-step-reshuffled targets: loss 0.04268 >= 0.5*bp2 0.03288 -> no fit from a signal-free target

preconditions.name: lever_KP_moves_feedback
preconditions.note: KP updated G every step (feedback-learning ON); freezing it (fixed_fa) leaves G unchanged=True

preconditions.name: transport_free_not_a_copy_of_Wt
preconditions.note: max |cos(G_l, W_l^T)| at INIT = 0.286 (< 0.8 -> NOT a copy; a W^T copy would read ~1.0). G is a SEPARATE random stream; the credit path reads G not W^T; KP updates G by the matched local delta. cos(G,W^T) RISES through training (deep bw-align init -0.002 -> final 0.931) -> co-adapted, not transported.

preconditions.name: kp_fit_differs_from_fixed_dfa
preconditions.note: the KP fit must differ from the fixed-DFA baseline's fit

verdict: GO: LEARNED FEEDBACK REACHES THE 3rd HIDDEN LAYER. Transport-free KP-learned feedback closes 55% of the BP-depth-2 -> BP-depth-3 FIT gap (>= 50%), where the fixed-DFA baseline closes only -17% (stays at the mean-predictor). KP loss 0.01401 vs bp3 2.064e-05 / bp2 0.03288 / dfa 0.03687. Freezing the feedback (kp-lr=0 -> fixed_fa) collapses it to -30% gap-close -- the win is DUE TO learning G. Transport-free: cos(G,W^T) init 0.286 -> deep-layer final 0.931 (co-adapted, not copied). Deep(a1) DFA-vs-BP align -0.262 -> KP 0.474. On 3/3 testable seeds.
